# Tyler Stevens — tylerstevens.me

Tyler Stevens is a builder at the intersection of Bitcoin and energy.

## About

Founder & CEO of Exergy (https://exergy.energy), commercializing hashrate heating —
using Bitcoin miners as intelligent heat sources for homes and businesses.

Board Member, 256 Foundation (https://256foundation.org) — nonprofit protecting
open-source Bitcoin mining software.

Founder & Organizer, Hashrate Heatpunks (https://heatpunks.org) — community for
hashrate heating practitioners, under the 256 Foundation.

Co-Founder, The Space (https://denver.space) — Denver's Bitcoin citadel.

Author, "Bitcoin Mining Heat Reuse" — free PDF at:
https://braiins.com/books/bitcoin-mining-heat-reuse
